checks: ruff check and format for changed Python files
cli_execution: CLI tests and benchmarks ran with normal host process-statistics access; sandboxed CLI supervision failed before simulation.
semantic_changes: Only contiguous dense prefixes are supported; any dense layer after a routed layer rejects with NotImplementedError.
Full-batch prefix and embedding run once; no-prefix models retain their previous execution.
Prefix latency, energy, verification token count, activation peak and KV preflight use full A-replica batch.
Five affected replay goldens refreshed; unchanged request/input/output totals; nine pure-routed golden cases unchanged.

cost_assessment.preparation: O(layers) validation and one usize of prepared state; no retained cache added.
cost_assessment.queries: Full prefix uses the existing op cache at full shape, clears it once, then reuses it for routed microbatches. No additional query-sized cache allocation.
cost_assessment.pipeline: O(microbatches * routed_layers) instead of walking dense layers per microbatch.
cost_assessment.measurement_limit: Six adjacent alternating pairs per row, no CPU pinning; a bounded local comparison, not a formal statistical gate or serving-accuracy qualification.
